documents.title: University of Wyoming syllabus template with sample AI language
documents.quality_note: Syllabus template recommending an AI section with four sample options (prohibited, permission, acknowledgement, free); AI is one paragraph of a long template.

notes: UW Regulation 2-114 (academic dishonesty) and the uwyo.edu/as academic-dishonesty page were fetched but contain no AI text, so excluded. President's AI Initiative page (uwyo.edu/president/initiatives/ai4wy) is generic and excluded. Third-party summaries (trinka.ai) mention a Feb 2026 policy update, not verified on an official page. No School of Computing AI policy found.
